evidenceNotes.observation: The pinned diff e79463b94ff6d3ad87526b3c68b38b90e924ea42..eab78ff696f3de8ae226f930e08b93d20ffbdb66 is byte-identical to the 9,492-byte stored artifact (SHA-256 6906187983eb2d3fb76b6b208f2f954fb92b8855c940e9b711347c36e3b79965); merge base, trees 8c42372cca4b0be9f0d2f75833a3abfba7fe904a and 72fcd0063020977f14c2c15bdd8d9233e78c4a28, and 5-file +40/-16 stats match. V3 correctly supersedes the noncanonical v1/v2 diff hash.

For ordinary refresh-loaded local files, Pattern.type reaches File.type, CSS and HTML consume it, but the script branch computes SCRIPT_TYPE[fileExt] and otherwise text/javascript. Extensionless Dart/module files and explicit script-type overrides therefore produce the wrong script MIME type.

The authenticated reviewer comment is bound to the original head and proposes the missing override. The later source computes scriptFileType from fileType before the extension and adds supported script types, corroborating consequence and repair boundary.
